Title: Mobile Services Integration with Sencha Touch

Body.Content: We've partnered with Sencha to add support for SenchaTouch to Mobile Services. SenchaTouch is an HTML/JavaScript-based development framework for building cross-platform mobile apps and websites. With today’s addition, you can add Mobile Services to your SenchaTouch app. Get started, or learn more on the Sencha extension resources page.
